# Incident report: checkout payment failures (2026-11-05)

**Severity:** SEV1. checkout-web error rate was 17.6%, above the 10% SEV1 threshold for checkout.
**Duration:** about 14:02 to 14:30 UTC (~28 min)
**Status:** Mitigated. Recovery confirmed by metrics.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41: payments-api deploy dep_7781 (v2.14.0). Healthy afterwards (p99 412 ms at 13:55). Not involved.
- 14:02: flag change **flg_2210**: `tax_engine_v2` rollout went from 10% to 100% on payments-api (by release-train).
- 14:02: tax-service `/v2/quote` queue depth reached 812 against a limit of 200. Log message: "v2 quote path is provisioned for 10% of traffic". payments-api p99 latency went from 420 to 3150 ms, and TaxEngineV2 calls began timing out at 3000 ms.
- 14:03: checkout-web error rate went from 0.3% to 17.6% ("payment step failed: payments-api 502").
- 14:05: search-api deploy dep_7790. This came after the error onset and touched an unrelated service, so it is not the cause (search-api only has a latency warning).
- 14:07:44: payments-api DEBUG log line contains a live bearer token in the request headers (see Security).
- ~14:27: Status page updated to "identified". `tax_engine_v2` set back to 10%. payments, storefront and security teams paged.
- 14:30: checkout-web error rate back to 0.4%, payments-api p99 back to 450 ms. Status page updated to "mitigated".

## Root cause
Change flg_2210 ramped `tax_engine_v2` from 10% to 100%. That sent all checkout tax quotes to the tax-service `/v2/quote` path, which is only provisioned for 10% of traffic. The v2 path ran out of workers and timed out. As a result, payments-api `/charge` returned 502 ("tax quote unavailable"), and checkout-web failed at the payment step. The `/v1/quote` path stayed healthy throughout.

## Mitigation
Set the `tax_engine_v2` flag back to its previous rollout of 10%. No rollbacks were done; the payments-api and search-api deploys were not linked to the errors.

## Verification
- checkout-web error_rate_pct: 17.6% before, 0.4% at 14:30 (under 1%).
- payments-api p99: 3150 ms before, 450 ms at 14:30–14:31.

## Security
A payments-api DEBUG log line at 2026-11-05T14:07:44Z contains a live Authorization bearer token for tax-service. The security team has been paged to rotate the token and purge the logs. The secret is not repeated in this report.

## Follow-ups
- payments and tax-service owners: size `/v2/quote` capacity before ramping again, and ramp in stages with automatic halt on errors or latency.
- payments: stop logging outbound request headers at DEBUG level, and rotate the exposed token.
- Review whether the release-train can ramp flags straight to 100%.

## Teams paged
payments (owner of payments-api), storefront (owner of checkout-web), security (token in logs).
